name: 1Key Password Manager
description: 1Key is a local-first password manager for Android. Your vault lives on your device, encrypted with a key only you hold, and never moves unless you export it yourself. There is no account to create, no server to breach, and no network connection of any kind — the INTERNET permission is stripped from the manifest, so the operating system itself enforces the offline guarantee.

name: 500 - Card game
description: 500 is the classic trick-taking card game of Australia and New Zealand. Outbid the other side, call trumps, and steer your partnership to 500 points — with the Joker, both bowers, and the ever-tempting Misère along the way. New to 500?

name: Adiresy
description: Adiresy is a native Android client for Adiresy, an unofficial addressing service for Madagascar. Madagascar has no formal street-addressing system in most areas. Every building can still get a short, permanent code anchored to GPS coordinates (for example 101-6EAR-50418). This app lets people find, share, and navigate to those codes — working on low-end phones, and, progressively, fully offline.

name: AIPOS Password Manager
description: AIPOS Password Manager is a premium, fully offline, and highly secure Android application for storing passwords, API keys, and 2FA secrets. Designed with modern Material You guidelines, hardware-backed cryptography via Android Keystore, and a local-first architecture.

name: Ambio: Focus Timer & Sounds
description: Ambio turns focus time into an environment you build yourself. Pick up to three ambient sounds, set how loud each one sits in the mix, and the whole app answers — colour, light and motion follow what you made. THE MIXER Twelve sounds, three at a time, each with its own level. Rain over a distant café. Fireplace under wind. Ocean with crickets at dusk.

name: AnDraw
description: AnDraw shows an image full screen and switches off touch, so you can put a sheet of paper on the screen and trace the image without your palm scrolling, zooming or opening something else. Adjust mode lets you place the image: pinch to zoom, drag to move, and buttons to rotate and mirror.

name: Anonomi Messenger
description: Anonomi Messenger is a privacy-first communication tool designed for situations where networks are monitored, infrastructure is hostile, and trust assumptions fail. It is built for people who cannot afford to be naive about surveillance, centralization, or metadata. Features: * Secure messaging — Peer-to-peer communication with no central servers to seize or subpoena.

name: Anti-Vocale
description: Anti-Vocale transcribes voice messages from WhatsApp, Telegram, and other messaging apps directly on your Android device. All processing happens on-device: your audio never leaves your phone. BUILT-IN MODELS - Parakeet TDT (recommended): fast, 25 European languages.

name: Arcade
description: Arcade is a minimal, Material You-themed game launcher. It allows you to block offline games from accessing the internet using a VPN. This saves battery, blocks ads, and protects your privacy.

name: Argus
description: Argus is a Tasker-class automation app where a large language model is the compiler, not the executor. You describe a rule in plain language — "every day at 9 send me the BTC price", "when I leave home turn off Wi-Fi", "if an OTP arrives, copy it to the clipboard". The model compiles your request into a structured, typed rule (trigger, conditions, actions).

name: Arrow Escape: Infinite Puzzle
description: Unwind and challenge your brain with Arrow Escape, a clean, minimalist puzzle game built purely for the love of play. Navigate intricate mazes of arrows by finding the right sequence to clear the board. Simple to pick up, satisfying to master, and endlessly engaging, Arrow Escape offers a distraction-free gaming experience designed to respect your time, device, and privacy.

name: Astro Loop
description: A roguelike shooter caught in a loop you were never meant to escape. Signal acquired. One ship, one pilot, and a crew waiting to be recruited. Fly out into the dark, survive endless waves of asteroids and enemies, and see how far you get before the difficulty catches up with you. Every run you pick fresh weapons and upgrades.

name: Atrium
description: Atrium is a controller for the servers you already run. Point it at your own machines and manage the whole stack from your phone, without a middleman account and without anything phoning home. It is a controller, not a media player. Atrium browses and manages your media servers; it does not stream video.

name: AutoPie
description: AutoPie is a command automation hub for Android. It gives you a Linux environment where you can create, run, and automate Bash commands or Python scripts without using a terminal. Use it to build small Android utilities for file conversion, downloads, monitoring, backups, web requests, AI tooling, device workflows, and any other task you would normally solve with Linux packages or scripts.

name: Axichat
description: Axichat is an open source email and chat client with first-party push notifications (without FCM) and a conversation-focused interface. Get your.name@axi.im at https://axi.chat/register. For additional privacy and security, run your own server by following the self-hosting guide at https://github.com/axichat/selfhost.

name: Backgammon Clock
description: A backgammon clock and scorekeeper for two players sharing one phone between them. The app asks for no permissions at all. There is no network access, no analytics, no accounts, no ads, and nothing to configure before you can use it. The whole clock is a single HTML file inside the app. Features - Large area with the remaining total time/delay time for this move.

name: Baluchon
description: Baluchon helps you manage shared expenses with friends or family during a trip (vacation, weekend, group travel...). Main features: * Create a trip and group your participants by family (optional). * Assign a weight to each participant (normal share = 1, half share for a child for example), individually adjustable for each expense.

name: Bati — Fitness RPG
description: Train like a hero, build like a king. Bati turns strength training into a dark-fantasy RPG. A workout is a quest. Reps land as damage on a boss. The muscles you actually work raise the buildings of a village that grows out of what you lifted, not out of what you bought. SPORT FIRST, RPG SECOND The training logic leads and the game amplifies it.

name: Battery Tile
description: Quick Settings tile showing battery current/temperature/time/status. This app has no launcher icon. It must be added in the Quick Settings panel. Tap to switch the view. Long-press to open the battery settings page. Not all devices will support all types of information.

name: BayesianBahn
description: Early release: predictions are experimental — always cross-check times and connections with DB's official apps. BayesianBahn predicts when you will actually arrive — as a full probability distribution, not a single number.

name: Bike Radar
description: Bike Radar shows and sounds what your rear bike radar sees, on top of whatever app you are already running. A thin strip down the edge of the screen shows each approaching vehicle's distance, closing speed and lateral position over your map or navigation app.

name: BikeTrackd
description: BikeTrackd is a cycling speedometer and GPS tracker built for Android with Jetpack Compose and Material 3.

name: BinClockWidget
description: An AMOLED-black, monochrome binary-clock Android home-screen widget. It renders the current time and date as a 6×4 grid of dots. Cells that would otherwise go unused carry a couple of small extras: the device alarm state and a weather glyph. The aesthetic is deliberately austere — solid dots on true black, no chrome, no colour — so it disappears into an AMOLED wallpaper and sips battery.

name: Block Blast
description: A minimal, privacy-focused block puzzle game

name: Block Craft 3D：Building Game
description: Have fun building your city in this 3D simulation game!

name: Boardgame Pal
description: Your trusty companion for every game night – simple, ad-free, free! Sound familiar? You want to start game night, but you don't have the right die, there's an argument about who goes first, and keeping score on paper is a hassle? Boardgame Pal solves all of these problems in a single, minimalist app. No registration, no loading times, no frills. Just open the app and start playing right away!

name: Bote
description: Bote manages the shared accounts of a group of people: create one card per event, note who paid for what and how it is split, and get the final report with the minimum set of transfers needed to settle up. Features: * Event cards with avatar, date, location, title and description. * Attendees added from your contacts or by hand, each with a colored initials avatar.

name: Bruno's Meditation Timer
description: Bruno's Meditation Timer is a simple, offline meditation and pranayama timer. Features: * Meditation timer with custom presets, each with configurable starting, intermediate, and ending bells. * Pranayama timer with auditory and visual guidance and generated breath tones. * Session logging, CSV import/export, streak tracking with streak repair, and basic statistics.

name: Canva: AI Photo & Video Editor
description: Generate with a prompt. Turn your ideas into actual videos, photos, or elements.

name: CapCut -  Download
description: CapCut is a mobile video editor built for editing footage directly on a phone, without moving files to a desktop first. It includes a timeline-based editor for trimming, splitting, and arranging clips, along with transitions, text overlays, and speed adjustments. The app also offers audio tools such as background music and voice-over recording, plus a library of filters and visual effects for adjusting color and style. Templates are available for common formats like short-form vertical video, which can speed up editing for social media clips. CapCut supports exporting finished videos in resolutions suitable for sharing on most platforms, making it a fairly complete option for people who want to shoot, edit, and publish a video entirely from their phone.

name: CapCut Premium
description: CapCut is a free video editing program that enjoys unprecedented success among users of social networks, particularly in short-form sections such as Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok—making their perfectly edited short videos easy-to-produce.

name: CBG -- Clavierhaus BackGammon
description: CBG Pro is the complete GNU Backgammon engine on Android -- and 1.0.0 is a major update that turns a strong backgammon app into the most capable analysis and training tool on the platform. It is not "based on" GNU Backgammon: it IS GNU Backgammon 1.08.003, vendored verbatim, with neural-net weights byte-identical to the desktop release. Every number on screen is the engine's own.

name: Chat Room
description: An Android client for the Chat Room real-time messaging server. Built with Jetpack Compose, OkHttp, and Socket.IO, it provides a modern interface for secure communication.

name: ChatGPT
description: Your AI assistant for writing, search, image generation, and more

name: Chompass - Calorie Tracker
description: Chompass is an ad-free, privacy-focused calorie tracker forked from Fud AI. Log meals with photos, voice, barcode scans, or text. Bring your own cloud AI key (Google AI Studio, OpenRouter, etc.) or use optional on-device Gemma 4 inference. Nothing is sent to a server unless you choose a cloud provider.

name: CHRONOS
description: CHRONOS allows you to schedule SMS message delivery for a specific date and time, without replacing your default messaging app.

name: ClaviRom
description: Customizable open-source keyboard with a flavour of Swiss-Romansh

name: ClayModeller
description: Create 3D models for clay printing with intuitive touch sculpting

name: Clockwork: 2FA Authenticator
description: Clockwork is a two-factor authenticator (2FA) that generates TOTP codes entirely on your device. It declares no INTERNET permission at all — the app cannot open a connection, and you can check that in the manifest before you believe a word of this. That is the difference. Most authenticator apps hold network access for sync, service icons or update checks.

name: Conceal Mobile
description: Conceal Mobile is the official mobile wallet for the Conceal Network blockchain, providing a secure and private way to manage your CCX cryptocurrency.

name: Couchy Launcher
description: A lightweight home launcher for Android TV & Google TV. No ads. No tracking. No accounts. Just your apps.

name: crocson
description: Easily and securely send things from one computer to another

name: Crystal Ball
description: Crystal Ball listens to your guitar and tells you what chord you just played. Press Detect single chord, strum, and it names the chord and draws how to fret it — with the chords it nearly picked instead one tap away, and other ways to play the same one further up the neck. Capture a whole part and it becomes a song sheet you can keep, correct and share. Early-stage release — expect rough edges.

name: Currency Converter
description: 💱 A simple, fast currency converter using rates from the Central Bank of Russia (CBR) or market (mid-market) rates. Available in English and Russian (follows the system language). Features: • Two rate sources — 🇷🇺 CBR and 🌐 market (mid-market) rate. • All CBR currencies, including less common ones. • "My currency" — a persistent home currency the summary is computed against.

name: Custom RR: ROMs & Recovery
description: Custom RR is a free, open-source companion app for the Android modding scene. It puts everything in one place: which custom ROMs and recoveries officially support your device, what Treble GSIs you can flash, and where to download them. No more bouncing between the LineageOS wiki, three Telegram channels, a SourceForge folder, and fourteen browser tabs.

name: Cyclauncher
description: Cyclauncher is not just yet another bicycle. Built with Jetpack Compose, it is focused on speed, effortless app accessibility, and seamless one-handed usability. New features and mechanics are continuously designed not just to be unique, but to deliver a genuinely convenient and ergonomic daily user experience.

name: Datamosh
description: Datamosh is a camera for creating live datamoshed video. Record a take as a sequence of hold-to-record segments. Add datamosh segments to carry motion from earlier footage into the next segment, or add a clean segment to reset the effect. Choose the resolution, frame rate, and supported video codec before beginning a take, and optionally use the inverted preview filter.

name: DAVY - Daika Anime Viewer because YOLO
description: DAVY is a modern, lightweight media player designed specifically for Android TV and Google TV platforms. It provides a seamless way to discover and stream anime directly on your TV. Content is currently available in Russian only. Built from the ground up with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, the app features a highly polished, TV-first interface.

name: Debate Timer
description: A simple timer designed for debaters specifically, so you can focus on speaking or judging. Tap anywhere to start and stop the timer. Press and hold while paused to reset the timer. The timing of bells can be customised: Ring a bell at the first and last minute, one minute before the end, or disable them entirely. Press and hold the top bar in to trigger a bell, and to test the volume.

name: DeBurrow
description: DeBurrow is a modern, native Android client for the Gopher protocol — the pre-web, text-first way to browse "Gopherspace". Built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

name: Defang
description: Defang is an Android launcher with an anti-dark-pattern friction layer. It is a speed bump, not a wall: you can still open Instagram, you can still override the timer. Nothing here is impossible to bypass — that is deliberate. A wall breeds circumvention; a speed bump breeds pause.

name: Denaro
description: Take control of your money without giving up your privacy. Denaro is a private, offline personal finance app for tracking accounts, income, expenses, transfers, debts and recurring transactions in one place. No account is required, and your financial data stays encrypted on your device.

name: Device Watch
description: Device Watch is an Android device monitor with a home-screen widget, per-app usage insights and an interactive screensaver for charging or docked use. It works completely offline: the app has no internet permission, and every number is real data read from Android and kernel sources — when a value is not available with the permissions granted, the app shows a dash instead of a fabricated value.

name: Diadem
description: Diadem is a next-gen GO Map. Use this app to connect to any Diadem Map covering your area. Features: • Connect to any Diadem Map • Modern UI • Great performance • Easy to use • 100% open-source This app is purely a client, you will connect to a backend hosted by third-parties. They will be responsible for how they collect and store your data.

name: DigiLocker
description: DigiLocker - a simple and secure document wallet
developer: National eGovernance Division, Government of India

name: Diktafon: Voice Memos on Tape
description: Diktafon is a voice recorder built around one idea: capturing a thought and finding it again later should feel effortless. Your memos live on cassettes — one tape per topic, like "shopping", "kitchen renovation" or "book ideas". Each cassette plays as one continuous tape of your recordings, in order, just like the real thing.

name: DNS Toggle
description: DNS Toggle is a small Android app that allows you to easily toggle and automate your phone's Private DNS through the Quick Settings panel. IMPORTANT: To modify Private DNS system settings, this app requires the WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission.

name: Do The Thing
description: Do The Thing is a personal coaching task manager that acts less like a static checklist and more like an active coach — surfacing what matters today and nudging you toward it. Features: * Seven task types: simple to-dos, deadlines, recurring tasks, randomized-interval tasks, important annual dates, timed goals, and daily habit check-ins.

name: Drill Press Assistant
description: Calculates the spindle speeds of a belt-driven drill press and recommends the optimal belt position for a given drill diameter and material. Describe your machine once — motor speed, pulley stacks, belts — and the app computes every achievable spindle speed, draws the transmission diagram, and tells you which belt position to use for the hole you are about to drill.

name: Droidrops
description: Droidrops is a fork of Readrops and a multi-services RSS client for Android. Its name is composed of "Read" and "drops", where drops are articles in an ocean of news.

name: Duolingo: Language Lessons
description: Lessons to learn Spanish, French, German, English, Online Chess, Math & Music

name: Einstein's Riddle
description: Einstein's Riddle (also known as the Zebra Puzzle)

name: ekklesia — Direct Democracy
description: ekklesia is an independent, open-source direct democracy platform for Greek citizens. Vote on real parliamentary bills, regional and municipal decisions — anonymously and securely. Features: • Citizen Voting — Vote Yes/No/Abstain on real bills from the Hellenic Parliament • Divergence Score — See how Parliament votes vs. citizens • Party Comparison — Which party agrees most with the people?

name: Emborg
description: Emborg lets you browse .org files on your device, view them with lightweight Org-aware formatting, and manage TODO items across all your files from a single task list.

name: Enclavd
description: Enclavd: A personality social network. Stop broadcasting into the void. Enclavd is a private social network built on compatibility. Take a personality quiz, get matched with people on your wavelength, and connect through a feed built around who you actually are. CORE PRINCIPLES Personality over Popularity: Your feed is filtered by personality. Find people who are on the same frequency.

name: Épione
description: Épione is a directory of French health facilities (hospitals, pharmacies, laboratories, health centres, maternal and child welfare centres…), based on the public FINESS open data from data.gouv.fr. Works fully offline: all data is bundled in the app and available without a connection.

name: Esca Agnellis
description: Esca Agnellis is a local Android app for friendly, low-pressure food-pyramid tracking. The app works without an account and without Internet permission. Tracking data stays on the device. There are no ads, telemetry, analytics, cloud sync, or automatic background data collection.

name: Eve Game Tracker
description: Eve Game Tracker is a tracker for card game results, currently supporting Skat, Poker, Durak, Gambio, and Uno, with the ability to add custom games. Features include a stats view, persistent player names, the option to disable games you don't play, and data export/import.

name: Facebook
description: A little connection can go a long way

name: FCS1
description: Streamline your hotel operations and workflows in one unified app in real-time

name: FediSuite
description: FediSuite is an open platform for the Fediverse: schedule posts, automatically split long posts into threads, get notifications from all your accounts in one place, and manage multiple accounts across 20+ platforms, including Mastodon, Pixelfed, PeerTube, Misskey, Friendica, WordPress (via the ActivityPub plugin) and BizzFed.

name: FeedTV
description: FeedTV is your personal news and entertainment hub, designed to be fast, lightweight, and private. Read your favorite media via RSS and enjoy a wide selection of open public and community TV channels and radio stations. Key features: - Modern and efficient RSS news reader. - Integrated public and community TV and radio streaming.

name: FilmFlip
description: Capture film negatives with your phone camera and recover them to normal photos. Features include automatic white balance, negative inversion, gamma/contrast/brightness/warmth adjustment, image rotation, cropping, and a built-in backlight for illuminating film strips.

name: Filmora: AI Video Editor&Maker
description: AI Video Generator: Background Remover, Text to Speech, AI Music, Templates

name: Firefox Fast & Private Browser
description: Private by default. Less tracking. Peace of mind built in.

name: FitBuddy
description: FitBuddy is a free, open-source health tracker for Android, with region packs that personalise diets and daily routines. Snap a photo or type what you ate — an LLM estimates calories and macros instantly. Review ingredients, tweak weights with live macro recalculation, and save. Bookmark favourite meals as presets for one-tap logging next time.

name: Folio
description: Folio is a reader for self-hosted RSS, built as a clean client for FreshRSS over the Google Reader API. Connect to your own server and read your feeds.

name: ForgetMeNot
description: A simple todo app with reminders and obsidian integration

name: Fossify File Manager
description: Tired of file managers that slow you down and invade your privacy? Unlock a lightning-fast, secure, and completely customizable experience with Fossify File Manager. ⚡ 🚀 DOMINATE YOUR DIGITAL WORLD WITH BLAZING-FAST NAVIGATION: • Swiftly manage your files with easy compression and transfer capabilities, keeping your digital life organized. • Quickly access your most-used folders with customizable

name: Fossify Gallery
description: Unleash memories, not personal data. Fossify Gallery is the ultimate photo and video app that's as powerful as it is private. No ads, no unnecessary permissions – just a seamless experience tailored for you. 🖼️ PHOTO EDITING AT YOUR FINGERTIPS: Enhance your photos with our basic yet powerful photo editor. Crop, resize, rotate, flip, draw, and apply stunning filters, all without compromising your

name: Fractals by Girino FOSS
description: Explore the Mandelbrot set and related fractals directly on your Android device. Pan, pinch, and double-tap to navigate; long-press to read complex coordinates. A bottom bar offers zoom, reset, export, and a menu for **12 formulas** (Mandelbrot, Burning Ship, Tricorn, Julia, Phoenix, and more) and **12 palettes** with preview swatches.

name: Free Fire MAX
description: MAX Battle Royale Experience

name: FreeProxy
description: FreeProxy turns any SOCKS5 or HTTP CONNECT proxy into a system-wide VPN on Android. Traffic from every app — or only the apps you pick — is captured by VpnService as raw IP packets, reassembled into TCP/UDP sessions in userspace, and forwarded through your upstream proxy. Apps with no proxy support of their own end up going through it anyway.

name: FreeView
description: FreeView is a lightweight, ad-free reader for Medium articles. Share a Medium link to FreeView (or paste it into the app) and it opens the full article through the free reader service of your choice - no browser clutter and no login.

name: GeauxWeather
description: Clean, fast, no-ads weather with radar, storms, and places

name: GitNote
description: Android note app with real file. Can be sync with git providers such as Github * create/open/clone repositories * notes search (global and from specific folder) * grid view * tree view * edit view * private repo (SSH and HTTPS) * remote sync * time based sort

name: Global Send
description: Global Send lets you send encrypted messages anywhere in the world without signing up for any account. It achieves better speed and latency by using direct connections instead of sending messages through a central server This app still uses relay servers to discover the address of the recipient before making the direct connection.

name: Glyfen
description: Glyfen is an offline-first OCR app for Android that lets you search your photo library by text content. All processing happens entirely on your device — no cloud uploads, no internet required. Point Glyfen at your photo folders and it scans every image for text using PaddleOCR.

name: Google’s Find Hub
description: Find devices, other items, and share location with friends and family.

name: Goregram
description: A Telegram fork with minimal extra features

name: Guandan 掼蛋
description: Please note: the interface is currently available in Chinese only. An English translation is planned for a future release. Guandan (掼蛋) is a Chinese climbing card game for four players in two partnerships, played with two decks. Teams start at level 2 and work their way up to Ace, and the red hearts of the current level are wild — they can stand in for any card.

name: Håck mas Castle 2026 Fahrplan
description: https://hack-mas.at Håck ma’s Castle ist ein offenes Schloss für alle Arten von Nerds. Wir wollen das Schloss als inklusiven Ort nutzen, als einen niederschwelligen Einstieg, um Wissen zu vermitteln und Erfahrungen auszutauschen. Håcken steht dabei für den kreativen Umgang mit Technik zum Beispiel bei Computern, Nähmaschinen, der Gesellschaft und Herdplatten (Essen ist wichtig!).

name: Happy Moments
description: Happy Moments is a simple, private app to help you remember the good things in life. Take or pick photos, add meaningful notes, and keep your memories organized and secure on your device. All data stays on your phone.

name: Harbor
description: Harbor creates a standard Android work profile to isolate applications and their data from your personal profile. Core features include work-profile setup, a searchable work-app list, freeze and unfreeze, launch, application details, and user-confirmed uninstall. Harbor contains no advertising, analytics, accounts, or network access.

name: Heart Rate Monitor
description: A lightweight heart rate monitoring app for Android, built with Jetpack Compose and Material 3. Connect to BLE heart rate monitors and track your heart rate in real time.

name: Hermes Mobile
description: A native Android companion app for Hermes Agent — the open-source, multi-platform AI assistant by Nous Research. Manage your Hermes agent directly from your phone over your trusted LAN, without needing to pull out a laptop or switch to another messaging platform.

name: Hestia
description: Hestia controls your Shelly smart-home devices (Gen2 and later) directly on your local network, over HTTP, through their built-in API. No cloud, no account, no telemetry: nothing leaves your network, by default. Features: * Channel dashboard with state and switch, at a glance. * "On for X" timer executed by the device itself, fully autonomously (the phone can be turned off).

name: HomeFeed - RSS Widget
description: HomeFeed is a customizable RSS feed widget. Key Features: • Multi-Feed Support: Consolidate multiple RSS feeds into a single, unified widget for a centralized news experience. • Integrated Reader Mode: Access article content through a distraction-free popup, allowing for quick reading without switching applications.

name: Huda
description: Huda is a comprehensive Islamic companion app designed to support your daily worship and spiritual growth. It brings the tools Muslims need most into one clean, ad-free experience. Features: * Quran: complete Mushaf in authentic Uthmanic script, translations and Tafsir, audio recitations with offline playback, and smart reading-position tracking.

name: Hue Spill
description: A simple, relaxing, yet incredibly challenging puzzle game. Features - Endless Levels: The game gets progressively harder as you play. The board gets bigger, more colors are added, and you have fewer moves to spare! - Random Puzzles: Just want a quick challenge? Play a random puzzle on Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty. - Undo Move: Made a mistake? Use the undo button to go back a step.

name: Hupl
description: Hupl is a simple file uploader for Android. Share files from any app directly to your configured HTTP upload servers.

name: I Keep Having This Dream
description: In this strategy-roguelike, build a path of tiles to escape each successive cycle of your dreamscape. A cycle grows more dangerous the longer you stay, so plan your route carefully and make the most of the challenges and opportunities you meet along the way.

name: IM2SMS
description: A simple app to import IM chat histories into Android’s SMS storage. Features Easy Import: Import chats directly from an IM app's share menu or by browsing the phone's storage for exported chat files. Chat Preview: Preview individual chats before importing into SMS. Material You: The app's theme and icon automatically adapts to the phone's wallpaper and system colours.

name: Infra Arcana
description: Infra Arcana is a Roguelike set in the early 20th century. The goal is to explore the lair of a dreaded cult called The Church of Starry Wisdom. Buried deep beneath their hallowed grounds lies an artifact called The Shining Trapezohedron - a window to all secrets of the universe. Your ultimate goal is to unearth this artifact.

name: InselChaos 2026
description: A schedule app for the InselChaos conference on the island of Rügen. Browse the program by day and room, search and filter sessions, save favorites, set alarms for individual talks, and add sessions to your personal calendar.

name: Instagram
description: Create & share photos, stories, & reels with friends you love

name: Iris Keyboard
description: Advanced FOSS keyboard with AI Copilot, translation, and key sound synthesis

name: Jargon
description: Jargon is a fully offline reader for the Jargon File — the hacker culture dictionary that gave the word "hacker" its original meaning, decades before it came to mean "cracker." Compiled by Eric S. Raymond and Guy L. Steele and continued today as a community project, it's the closest thing hacking has to an etymology.

name: JioHotstar
description: Micro shows on Tadka, endless sports, entertainment. Infinite possibilities.

name: Journal Multilingual
description: Journal Multilingual is an open-source Android app for tracking substance use and accessing harm reduction information. It is a community fork of PsychonautWiki Journal with additional language support.

name: Karabau
description: Karabau is an open-source Android client for Karakeep, built entirely with Jetpack Compose. Use it to keep your bookmarks in one place, with a native mobile experience focused on speed and simplicity.

name: kiFOSSk
description: kiFOSSk is a lightweight, open-source kiosk browser designed to turn your Android device into a dedicated display for remote dashboards. Whether you're monitoring ADS-B flights, viewing Home Assistant dashboards, or running digital signage, kiFOSSk provides a reliable, privacy-first solution. Key Features: • Home Launcher Mode: Automatically starts on boot without complex Device Owner setup.

name: kinemaster Premium  apk
description: Kinemaster mod apk with all premium features unlocked and without watermarks for video editing and high-quality video exports without charges

name: Kiosk
description: Kiosk is a Hacker News reader for Android. It is built around reading, not browsing. Browse Hacker News feeds, search historical stories, read articles in a distraction-free native reader, and keep comments close at hand. Features: - Browse Top, New, Best, Ask, Show, and Jobs. - Search historical Hacker News stories. - Read articles in a native reader powered by Mozilla Readability.

name: Knit
description: Knit is a messenger that works with no internet, no cell service, and no accounts. It connects directly to the phones around you over Wi-Fi Aware and Bluetooth, passing messages device to device. When you send a message, nearby phones receive it and pass it onward to the phones around them — so your words hop across a crowd, a building, or a campsite, far past your own signal range.

name: Kryptos
description: Kryptos encrypts messages directly inside the chat, so you never have to switch between apps. The Kryptos keyboard installs like any other system keyboard: enable it once, and it will be available everywhere you type. Write a message in WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS, tap the lock icon, and the text in the input field is instantly replaced with ciphertext ready to send.

name: LaBLEr
description: LaBLEr is a label printer app for Bluetooth Low Energy thermal label printers of the Marklife family (P15, P12, L13). Design your own labels right on your phone, save them as templates, and print them again anytime. It talks to the printer directly over Bluetooth LE, with no account, no cloud, and no vendor app.

name: Lavender Photos
description: Lavender Photos is a no non-sense, stylish, and performant gallery app for Android. Features Smooth Browsing: Browse all your photos and videos smoothly, separated by date Flexible Albums: Add and remove albums as you wish, no arbitrary or forced selections Smart Search: Search for an image by its name, date or tag!

name: Lector
description: Lector reads your documents aloud — beautifully, privately, and completely free. Open a TXT, Markdown, EPUB, or PDF — a single file or a whole folder — or paste text, or share to Lector from any app. Lector turns it into a clean, paged reader and reads it to you using your device's own voices, highlighting the current sentence as it goes.

name: LegacyPhotoFrame
description: LegacyPhotoFrame is a free, open-source photo frame app built for legacy devices. It is designed to run on bare-minimum systems that cannot support other functionality. DISCLAIMER: AI Usage All code and documentation written for this project was done by hand, by humans. Please consult the README in our source code for more information.

name: Levyra
description: Native music streaming, playback, lyrics, downloads, and private insights

name: Libre Contacts Backup
description: Libre Contacts Backup is a FLOSS native Android app for private, local-first contact backups. No account, no cloud, no tracking — your contacts never leave your device unless you choose to move the backup file yourself.

name: LibreAAC
description: LibreAAC is a free, ad-free augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) app for Android tablets. It works offline and keeps communication boards and preferences on the device. Select words or symbols to speak them and build a phrase. Move between linked boards, return home, or speak the complete phrase when it is ready. Speech uses the voices installed on the device.

name: LibreCuts Beta
description: LibreCuts is a free and open-source video editor for Android focused on simplicity, performance, and privacy. Edit and export watermark free videos entirely on your device. Note: LibreCuts is currently in beta. You may encounter bugs, instability, or incomplete features as development continues. Features Trim: Remove unwanted parts from the beginning or end of a video.

name: LibreNotes
description: LibreNotes is a private, self-hosted note-taking app with end-to-end encryption. Your notes are stored only on your own server — no cloud accounts, no third-party services, no tracking.

name: LibreStatus
description: LibreStatus lets you view and keep the photo and video statuses you see in WhatsApp, so a status you liked doesn't disappear after 24 hours. The app works entirely on your device. It has no internet permission, collects no data, contains no ads and no trackers.

name: LimeLog
description: LimeLog is a periodized strength-training tracker. Features: * Build programs with phases * Log every set and rep * Auto-detect personal records (Epley 1RM) * Progressive-overload reference while logging * Estimated 1RM trends with a per-exercise PR history * Optional vertical-jump and body-metric tracking * Health Connect steps and active calories Local-first; optional account-gated cloud sync.

name: Link Clear
description: Link Clear strips tracking parameters from URLs using the bundled ClearURLs ruleset. It works entirely offline by default: paste or share a link, and get back the same link with the tracking noise removed. Three ways to clean a link: * Share target — share a link to Link Clear from any app. You land on a confirmation screen showing the cleaned URL with Copy, Share, and Open actions.

name: Little Painter
description: Little Painter is a finger-painting app for toddlers that keeps the phone locked to the canvas, so little artists can draw freely without calling anyone, opening the camera, or wandering into your email.

name: LocalSend
description: LocalSend is an open source app to share files and messages between nearby devices using the local wifi network. The communication between devices is entirely end-to-end encrypted via HTTPS. No Internet required. No tracking*. No ads. Currently, this app is available on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux. You can find all download options on the official homepage. *The operating system may sti

name: Loophole
description: Loophole is a one-tap Quick Settings toggle for Android Developer Options. If you're an Android developer, Developer Options is basically always on. But a lot of banking and fintech apps treat that as a red flag and refuse to open, or silently degrade, while it's enabled -- even though you're not doing anything shady, you're just building.

name: Ludo King®
description: Ludo King is a board game played between friends and family. A fun dice game.

name: Luteal
description: Luteal is a private, offline-first menstrual cycle tracker that clearly separates recorded facts from calculated estimates. Key features: - Offline by default: Your data stays in a local database on your device with no account required. - Honest tracking: Distinguishes recorded observations from statistical estimate ranges. No medical claims or automated diagnoses.

name: MA Astronomy
description: An AR night sky viewer. This app helps you find planets, stars, and constellations in the night sky.

name: Mage
description: Mage is an Android GUI for age file encryption, built on kage (a Kotlin/JVM implementation of the age protocol). "Mage" is short for Mobile age. Mage is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by the age project. Encrypt or decrypt files to age recipients or passphrases, including armor, multi-recipient, and encrypt-to-self.

name: Mahjong Solitaire
description: Classic tile-matching puzzles without interruptions, tracking, or ads.

name: Malarm
description: Flexible no-frills alarm scheduler, free and open source

name: Markor
description: 📝 Create notes and manage your to-do list using simple markup formats 🌲 Work completely offline - whenever, wherever 👌 Compatible with any other plaintext software on any platform -- edit with notepad or vim, filter with grep, convert to PDF or create a zip archive 🖍 Syntax Highlighting and format related actions -- quick insert pictures and to-do 👀 Convert, preview, and share documents as HT

name: Match 3
description: Minimal and open-source Match-3 puzzle game

name: Meditate
description: Meditate is a friendly meditation timer that helps you build a consistent practice — with no accounts, no telemetry, and your data under your own control.

name: meine Gleitzeit - my flextime
description: myFlextime is the easy-to-use time calculator for everyone with a flexitime arrangement. Do you work flexitime and want to quickly find out how many hours you've worked today? Or when you can finish work at the earliest? MyFlextime calculates it for you – no ads/no costs simple, fast, and no fuss.

name: Mercurygram Tor Plugin
description: Tor companion plugin for Mercurygram. It runs the Tor daemon in a background service and exposes a local SOCKS5 proxy, which Mercurygram uses to carry MTProto traffic over the Tor network when the "Use Tor" option is enabled. The plugin ships separately so that the Tor binaries and the geoip databases, about 25 MB per architecture, are only downloaded by the people who actually use them.

name: MetroMusic
description: MetroMusic looks and moves like the Music + Videos hub of Windows Phone 8, and it plays what is already on the phone. No account, no feed, no recommendations. The collection is the start screen. The panorama you land on is the library — artists, albums, songs, genres, playlists, history and settings, in whatever order you put them.

name: Midnight
description: Midnight is a dream journal app for Android designed to be straightforward and easy to use, without any purchases or ads. It is and will remain free, and fully open source.

name: Mihrab
description: Mihrab keeps the five daily prayers close at hand: a calm home screen with the next salah and a live countdown, optional adhan reminders, a full-month planner, and home-screen widgets.

name: Milki Launcher
description: Milki Launcher is a custom Android home screen replacement built from scratch with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It focuses on speed, a clean interface, and powerful search capabilities. Features: Multi-Mode Search: Search apps, contacts, files, the web, and YouTube from a single search bar. Use prefixes to filter results: no prefix for apps, "s " for web search, "c " for contacts.

name: Minesweeper
description: Minesweeper is a native Android implementation of the classic puzzle game with configurable modes and an offline-first design.

name: MinkLauncher OpenSource
description: MinkLauncher OpenSource is a focused Android home-screen launcher and keyboard-first assistant designed around fast input and low visual noise. The responsive Home panel combines a preview of up to five to-dos with eight configurable icon shortcuts. Home slots and the compact drawer can open apps or actions published by apps, while every installed launcher app remains one keyboard search away.

name: Miroji
description: Miroji is a fast, simple mirror for your phone's front camera. Open it and you immediately see a live view from your front camera — just like looking into a mirror. No shutter, no saving, no sign-up. Private by design: nothing is ever recorded, stored, or sent anywhere. Miroji only asks for the camera permission, and the camera image never leaves your device.

name: Mirror
description: Mirror is a multi-protocol mirror-type backup application for Android. Designed to be simpler and lighter than synchronization software, it allows you to use your own infrastructure rather than third-party cloud services.

name: MorphCook
description: The same dish exists for every body. Most recipe apps treat dietary needs as filters that remove dishes from the world: go vegan and the Döner disappears, develop a nut allergy and Pad Thai is gone. MorphCook inverts this. Every dish exists as fully-authored variants — vegan Döner, gluten-free Alfredo, keto burger — and your profile decides which variant of each dish you see.

name: motd
description: motd is a native Android IRC client with a modern chat interface for direct IRC networks and soju bouncers. Connect directly to an IRC server or use a bouncer for persistent connections, multi-network access, synchronized history, read markers, and push delivery.

name: Multi Launcher ‧ Home Screen
description: Multi Launcher is a minimalist Android launcher that replaces app icons with clear, readable text buttons for easier navigation. It offers customizable layouts, fonts, and gesture shortcuts, using Android's Accessibility service for actions like locking the screen, plus a biometric lock for its settings. It states it does not collect or share personal data.

name: MX Player
description: Powerful video player with advanced hardware acceleration and subtitle supports

name: My Apps
description: A simple App Manager it helps you to keep tract of all installed apps on device

name: My Talking Angela
description: A singing, dancing fashion star from the makers of My Talking Tom!

name: My Talking Tom
description: It’s Talking Tom, the virtual pet cat who loves to chat.

name: My Talking Tom 2: Pet Game
description: Offline pet game: care for virtual cat Tom, play mini-games, explore worlds.

name: N-Zik
description: N-Zik is your ultimate, open-source, multilingual YouTube Music client for Android! 🎵🚀 A multilingual fork of Kreate , focused on performance, UI/UX polish, bug fixes, and new features with long-term support. Development & Stability: N-Zik started as a side project for myself and friends.

name: Navy Fleet Battle
description: Navy Fleet Battle is an Android version of Морской бой, the sea battle game played on squared paper across Russia for generations. It follows the classic Russian rules exactly, with no variants and nothing to configure.

name: NC Collectives
description: An unofficial native Android client for the Nextcloud Collectives app — wiki-style markdown notebooks hosted on your own Nextcloud server. Features: * Browse collectives and nested page trees.

name: Neruppu
description: Neruppu is a modern, offline-first physical security monitoring app that uses your device's sensors to detect and record security events.

name: Netflix
description: Netflix is the leading subscription service for watching TV episodes and movies.

name: NetToggle
description: NetToggle is a lightweight Android Quick Settings (QS) tile app for switching cellular network modes directly from Quick Settings. Many phones and carrier configurations hide or limit advanced network mode options, especially strict 5G/4G switching.

name: Neuron Encrypt
description: Neuron Encrypt is a local file encryption app that keeps your files private. No accounts, no internet, no cloud — everything happens on your device.

name: Nexus Command Center
description: Nexus Command Center is the hub of the Limecore suite — a personal life dashboard that combines five domains (Finance, Fitness, Studies, Work, Habits) into a single Life Score.

name: Night Drop
description: Night Drop is a privacy-first 1:1 messenger. Like a night deposit box: every message is a sealed envelope, dropped for one person only, opened by no one in between. * Anonymous identities only — no phone number, no email, no account. Your identity is a keypair held on your device. * End-to-end encryption with the Signal Double Ratchet: only the sender and receiver can read a message.

name: Nightbell
description: Point Nightbell at anything that answers over HTTP, or at one element on a rendered web page, and it watches it, charts it, and gets loud when it breaks. There is no server and no account. The phone in your pocket does the checking, and your API tokens and target URLs never leave the device. Three kinds of monitor: - Status check: hit a URL, assert on the status code.

name: Noir Gym
description: Noir Gym is a premium, no-fluff workout log for lifters who want more than a spreadsheet. Every set you log builds a real training profile — from your rep history to a full Fitness Score that grows as you do. 💪 LOG YOUR TRAINING Record any exercise with weight, sets, and reps in seconds.

name: Noise Timer
description: Noise Timer is a simple, private companion for sleep, focus, and quiet moments. Choose white, pink, or brown noise, adjust the volume, and let the sound play in the background. Set a sleep timer from a quick preset or choose your own duration. An optional fade-out gently lowers the volume during the final 20 seconds.

name: Nonogram
description: Nonogram is a free and open-source picture logic puzzle game. Use numerical clues along the rows and columns to fill in grid tiles and reveal hidden pixel art images. Designed to be lightweight and user-friendly, Nonogram offers a clean, distraction-free environment for casual puzzle solving and brain training.

name: Noppa Dice Roller
description: Dice roller suitable for complicated rolling with many modifiers and dice

name: NovaDial
description: 📞 SMARTER CALLING, DESIGNED FOR CLARITY NovaDial is a privacy-focused phone application built for users who want a clean, reliable, and efficient calling experience. Based on Fossify Phone and developed as an independent fork, NovaDial introduces significant improvements to call management, usability, and performance while remaining completely free and open source.

name: Obtainium
description: Obtainium allows you to install and update Apps directly from their releases pages, and receive notifications when new releases are made available. Read the Wiki Currently supported App sources: Open Source - General: GitHub GitLab Forgejo (Codeberg) F-Droid Third Party F-Droid Repos IzzyOnDroid SourceHut Other - General: APKPure Aptoide Uptodown itch.io Huawei AppGallery Tencent App Store vivo Ap

name: OMN-Go
description: OMN-Go is a self-hosted personal wiki and note application that uses Markdown. It runs a small local web server on your device and shows your notes in a browser-style interface. It needs no account, no cloud service, and no third party to keep working. A note is a plain Markdown file with a small header block (title, date, tags). OMN-Go compiles each note to a static HTML page.

name: OpenKuma
description: OpenKuma is a private, read-only Android client for Uptime Kuma, the self-hosted monitoring tool. Check the health of your services from your phone, without ever changing anything on your instance. OpenKuma is strictly read-only. It is 100% free and open source, sends no data to anyone, and has no ads, no tracking and no Google services.

name: Ordunte: Karrantza valley weather
description: Ordunte is a native Android app for hyperlocal weather in the Karrantza / Ordunte valley (Carranza, Bizkaia). Motto: El tiempo del valle. What it shows • In Carranza: Weather, Field, Hunting and Beekeeping. • Away from the valley: current, hourly and weekly forecasts, air quality when data is available, and rain radar for the current location.

name: OTG Master
description: OTG Master lets you mount VeraCrypt-encrypted USB mass-storage devices on Android without root access.

name: Pageless
description: Pageless is the native Android client for Pageless, a self-hosted audiobook server. It is offline-first: browse your library, download books for offline listening, play without a connection, and sync your progress back to your own server over its token-authenticated JSON API. You must run your own Pageless server; the app connects to a server URL that you configure on the login screen.

name: Paperless Go
description: A modern mobile client for your Paperless-ngx document management server.

name: PaperTerm
description: PaperTerm is an SSH terminal built for e-paper devices such as the Onyx Boox range, where screens redraw slowly and leave ghosting behind. It pairs the Termux terminal engine with a pure-Java SSH client, and adds the details that make a terminal usable on e-ink. It is a pure SSH client: there is no local shell and no local code execution.

name: Password Master
description: Password Master is open source app for generating, managing and storing passwords in a secure encrypted database. Generate secure passwords using cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generator. You are given options to choose which characters your password should contain or you can choose your set of a custom symbols. Generating, managing and storing passwords with Password Master is fast

name: Pause
description: Pause adds a short, timed pause before you open the apps you choose. When you launch a selected app, the screen is covered by a panel with a countdown. Only after it finishes can you choose Open anyway or Cancel. It turns an automatic tap into a deliberate choice. It is friction, not a hard block.

name: pcontacts
description: pcontacts signs in to your Proton Mail account, decrypts your contacts client-side using OpenPGP, and exposes them to the system Contacts app so they appear alongside your local contacts — the same way WhatsApp or Telegram surface their own contact directories. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Proton AG.

name: PDF Toolkit
description: PDF Toolkit is a comprehensive PDF and image manipulation tool for Android.

name: Personal Health Records
description: Personal Health Records helps you keep your own health measurements organized on your Android device. Record blood pressure, heart rate, weight, blood glucose, and uric acid. Review trends over time, and import or export data using CSV or Excel-compatible files. The app is available in Chinese and English. The app stores health records locally and does not upload them.

name: Pile
description: Pile is a simple and powerful document management app designed to help you organize, access, and share your personal files all in one place. Built around a flexible tag system called "piles", the app lets you categorize your documents the way you think, not the way folders force you to.

name: PocketTracker
description: PocketTracker is a music tracker in the spirit of LSDJ, LGPT and the M8 — built for Android gaming handhelds with physical buttons, with an on-screen control layout for phones.

name: Privacy Kit Lite
description: Privacy Kit Lite is the public, local-only edition of Privacy Kit. It lets you create reusable profiles for apps and configure supported Android identifier values for LSPosed runtime hooks. Supported modes include real values, static generated-once values, and manually entered custom values.

name: Private Internet Access VPN
description: Private Internet Access (PIA) is an open-source VPN client for Android. It encrypts your internet traffic and masks your IP address, helping protect your privacy on public Wi-Fi and other networks.

name: Proton Pass: Password Manager
description: Get the password manager created by the scientists who met at CERN behind Proton Mail, the world’s largest encrypted email provider. Proton Pass is open source, end-to-end encrypted, and protected by Swiss privacy laws. Pass offers more than other free password managers and has no ads or data collection. You can use it for free forever on all your devices to create and store unlimited passwords, a

name: Pulse
description: A Garmin-only fork of Gadgetbridge with a new look. It pairs with your Garmin watch over Bluetooth and keeps everything on your phone. No account, no vendor app, no cloud.

name: QSO Again
description: Record and playback amateur radio QSOs with Audioloop and quick rewind.

name: Quiet Grid
description: Quiet Grid is a collection of logic puzzles for Android. No ads, no tracking, no internet connection required — everything runs entirely on your device. Puzzles included: Chimp Test — Tap the numbers in order before they disappear. Takuzu — Fill a grid with 0s and 1s: each row and column must have equal counts, no three in a row, and no two rows or columns may be identical.

name: Quiet Rebellion
description: Quiet Rebellion gives you full control over your Bose QC Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen) directly over Bluetooth — without the Bose app, without a cloud account, and without sending any data off your device. It implements the BMAP protocol (Bose Messaging and Protocol), the same protocol the official app uses, accessed through the unauthenticated SETGET and START operators.

name: Quits
description: Quits is a privacy-preserving, shared expense splitting application built with Kotlin Multiplatform. The app allows to easily split expenses between multiple people and synchronize via a public or self-hosted, encrypted relay server. It supports multiple groups, members, split types, categories, etc.

name: Randomly/Die
description: Randomly/Die is a fast, playful random number generator. Roll dice, flip coins, generate hex or binary values, pick musical notes or decisions, and explore emoji and game modes. Features an extended dice notation console, quick mode buttons, history, and Sparkle Mode.

name: RapidSplit
description: Those who ride along pay along. Those who don't, don't. RapidSplit settles kayak, club and group trips fairly: leg by leg instead of flat rates. 🛶 PER-LEG TRAVEL COSTS Set up your trip as legs (e.g. outbound, shuttle, return) and mark who rode along on each leg. Only those people share that leg's costs. Settle via a per-km rate or by fuel costs split by kilometre share.

name: Relagent
description: Trustworthy AI assistant that runs 100% on your hardware

name: RelayPony
description: Send files from one phone to another, directly. RelayPony is a private, encrypted file transfer app that moves your photos, videos, documents, and any files device to device, with no servers, no account, and no cloud in between. Most file sharing apps upload your files to someone else's servers or bury you in ads. RelayPony does neither.

name: RemotePointer
description: With this app you can control your computer's keyboard and mouse (using a touchpad). Furthermore, you can project a digital laser pointer dot on your screen or projector, which is controlled by the movement of your Android device.

name: ReSearch
description: ReSearch is a fast Android dictionary reader for DSL-format dictionaries. Download, import, and search multiple dictionaries with instant article retrieval via DictZip random-access compression.

name: Resonance
description: Resonance is a music player for self-hosted, Subsonic-compatible servers such as Navidrome. Connect to your server and stream your own library.

name: ReteClock
description: An old Android phone in a drawer is still a perfectly good screen with a perfectly good clock in it. reteclock is for exactly that: plug the phone into a charger, put it on a stand, and it shows the time in large digits with the weekday and the date. Old phones are hard to use for much else.

name: ReteKey
description: A Hangul keyboard for developers and power users — for anyone who needs Esc, Tab, Ctrl chords, function and arrow keys on a phone, and a keyboard that behaves itself in a terminal. It is small and asks for almost nothing.

name: Ring-R
description: RingR turns any youtube video link into a custom ringtone, entirely on your device. Paste a link, and RingR pulls the audio down locally from youtube using the NewPipe extractor. Everything stays on your phone. Once the audio is ready, use the built-in audio trimmer to pick out exactly the clip you want and save it straight to your device's ringtone collection.

name: RumRummy
description: Get and Play Indian rummy 13 card game online multiplayers with RumRummy

name: Salty
description: Exchange sensitive information securely by encrypting messages with a shared "Salt" (Key). Built with a focus on privacy and modern design, it utilizes AES-256-GCM encryption and stores all history locally on your device. Key Features: - Secure Encryption: Industry-standard AES-256 with PBKDF2 (600,000 iterations). - Modern Design: Sleek Material Design 3 interface with expressive dark mode.

name: SayWhen
description: No forms, no fields. Just say when. Type an event the way you'd say it, in English or Russian: • Gym every tuesday and friday at 9 • Movie tomorrow at 11 for an hour and a half • Dentist june 3 at 12:30 SayWhen parses the phrase as you type — date, time, duration, recurrence — shows a live preview of what it understood, and writes the event straight to the calendar you chose.

name: scrcpy
description: This app mirrors a second Android device on your phone or tablet over Wireless ADB, the same way the desktop scrcpy tool does. The device running this app is the source; the target is any Android 11+ device with Wireless Debugging enabled. Video, audio, touch, key input, and clipboard are forwarded between them. No root is required on either side.

name: SearchLauncher
description: Your home screen opens with a keyboard. One bar finds everything on your phone and everything on the web, and opens what you find in a browser that blocks ads. SEARCH ANYTHING Apps, app shortcuts, contacts, device settings, downloads, calendar events for the coming week, text snippets and your own custom actions. Ranking learns from what you pick, so the next time is faster.

name: Seenema: Movie Tracker
description: Track the films and series you have watched, rate them out of five, and keep a list of what to watch next. No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your phone. Features: 🔍 Search films, series and people. ⭐ Rate in one tap a film or a series to add it to your seen list. 🕐 Watch later saves anything for later, and it moves over to your seen list once you rate it.

name: Sehat
description: Sehat (صحت, meaning health in Urdu) is a privacy-focused personal health tracker for Android. Track your steps, heart rate, and meditation while keeping your data on your device.

name: Signal Private Messenger
description: Custom description written by the admin, replacing the Play blurb.

name: SimpleDay
description: SimpleDay is a beautiful, minimalist diary app built around one simple idea: one entry per day. No feeds, no clutter, no accounts to sign up for — just a calm space to write. Write your thoughts, experiences, and memories in Markdown, and keep them private. Your entries stay on your device and, optionally, on a cloud server you control.

name: Skylib
description: Skylib is an alternative frontend for Bluesky that lets you browse local feeds and follows without a Bluesky account. It supports viewing profiles, posts, feeds, and your timeline, following users, and saving posts. All content is proxied through a Skylib instance, which can be self-hosted or public.

name: SmokingYou
description: SmokingYou is a minimalist, data-oriented smoking tracker for Android based on Material 3 Expressive. Key Features: - Habit Tracking: Log entries with a single tap, real-time smoke-free timer. - Home Screen Widgets: Quick Add widget (1x1) and live Timer & Counter widget (3x1). - Mindful Craving Pause: Guided breathing pause to resist cravings and track attempts.

name: SMSecure
description: 💬 SMSecure is a privacy-focused SMS messenger for Android. SMSecure is a fork of Silence/TextSecure, created to preserve encrypted SMS functionality on modern Android devices. It keeps the familiar feel of a classic SMS app while adding tools for private, verified conversations. 🔐 Encrypted SMS conversations Use end-to-end encrypted SMS with compatible contacts.

name: Snapchat
description: Share the moment!

name: Snore Detector
description: Snore Detector is a privacy-first, 100% open source Android app for real-time snore detection and sleep analysis. All audio processing happens entirely on your device—no cloud services, tracking, telemetry, or network connection required.

name: Solid Share
description: Solid Share brings the Solid ecosystem to everyday Android users. Sign in with your Solid pod and use it as a personal data wallet: browse and manage your files, keep your address book and your tickets and passes on it, and share any of it with the people you choose. Solid is an open web standard for personal data stores, called pods. Your pod is yours — pick a provider or run your own.

name: Spotify: Music and Podcasts
description: Listen to songs, play podcasts, create playlists and discover music you'll love

name: Status - Chat, Wallet, Browser
description: Status is your privacy companion for private, fully end-to-end encrypted messaging with friends, family, and business partners; a secure crypto wallet; a built-in browser for accessing websites and decentralized services; and decentralized, self-sovereign, censorship-resistant community spaces. - Anonymous user profiles: No phone number, email, or bank account required to create a Status profile.

name: Storii - audiobookshelf client
description: Audiobookshelf client with offline downloads and background playback

name: Subster
description: Subster is a pass-and-play music party game for your own music collection. A mystery song plays blind — no title, no artist, no year. Your job: place it on your timeline by guessing whether it came out before or after the songs you already hold. Guess right and you keep the card. First to 10 cards wins.

name: Subway Surfers
description: Help Jake, Tricky & Fresh escape from the grumpy Inspector and his dog!

name: Sudoku
description: A clean Sudoku app built with Flutter. Every puzzle is uniquely generated, and its difficulty is derived from the logical solving techniques required to complete it. Features: * Logic-based difficulty - difficulty is derived from the techniques needed to solve a puzzle (Hidden Single, Naked Pair, X-Wing, Swordfish, and more).

name: Super Productivity
description: Organize your daily tasks at one place while making time tracking a lot less annoying. Super Productivity is a ToDo List / Time Tracker / Personal Jira Task Manager for multiple platforms. Features Plan, track & summarize . Create time sheets and work summaries in a breeze to easily export them to your companies time tracking system. Integrate with Jira , Github and Gitlab . Auto import tasks assi

name: SyncRecord
description: SyncRecord is an open-source Android application designed to transform a group of spatially distributed smartphones into a single, synchronised, ad-hoc microphone array. This tool addresses the high cost and scalability limitations of traditional hardware microphone arrays, offering a low-cost solution for acoustic research, sound source localisation, and multi-device audio acquisition.

name: T2DECODE
description: Note: The application interface is currently in French only. T2DECODE is a local-first learning platform designed for IT enthusiasts, cybersecurity students, and network administrators. Features: - Privacy-focused: Fully functional offline, no telemetry, no tracking, and includes a global offline mode. - Interactive Labs: Network, System, Cloud, and Cryptography simulators.

name: Tallybook
description: Tallybook is a private, offline-first expense and budget manager for Android. Track your spending across multiple wallets, set budgets, plan recurring transactions, and see where your money goes, all on your device, with no account and no sign-up. Tallybook is a maintained, community fork of MoneyWallet by AndreAle94, a GPL-licensed expense manager whose last release was in 2021.

name: Tane
description: Tane (種, "seed"; from tanemaki 種まき, "to sow seeds") is a local-first, decentralized app for keeping and sharing traditional seeds. Every traditional seed is a letter written by thousands of generations, passed from hand to hand.

name: Tankblick
description: Current prices for E5, E10 and diesel at German filling stations — fetched quickly, with nobody looking over your shoulder.

name: TapLock
description: TapLock is a minimalist utility that lets you lock your screen with a double tap — perfect for one-handed use and quick screen locking without reaching for the power button. Create a resizable, transparent home screen widget and double-tap it to lock your phone instantly.

name: Telegram
description: Telegram is a messaging app with a focus on speed and security.

name: Temple Run 2
description: Run, jump, and escape in the ultimate endless jungle adventure game!

name: Tempus
description: Tempus is an open-source, privacy focused and lightweight music client for Subsonic, designed and built natively for Android. It provides a seamless and intuitive music streaming experience, allowing you to access and play your Subsonic music library directly from your Android device.

name: Terminator
description: Terminator is a Terminal emulator, offering comprehensive terminal emulator support with multi-session support you can directly customize and control. Its main purpose is a terminal emulation suitable for daily use. The main difference from other Terminator apps is only in the interface area — embedded terminal colors and a completely compact interface.

name: Tickdroid
description: Tickdroid is an Android companion app to the Nextcloud daily habit tracker application Tickbuddy. Please note that Tickdroid cannot be used as a standalone application, as it relies on the Tickbuddy/Nextcloud back-end. The application enables users to record whether a specific event has occurred or not on daily basis.

name: Tideo Auto Brightness
description: A glass-box replacement for Android's adaptive brightness

name: Tine
description: Tine is a fast, local-first outliner that reads and writes a real Logseq Markdown (and Org) graph on disk. It aims to feel like — and round-trip with — Logseq: the outliner, tasks and priorities, journals, page and block references, queries (with a visual builder), PDF and media, and HTML export.

name: Track Exploder
description: Track Exploder turns part-predominant barbershop learning tracks into the practice mix you need. Load the tenor, lead, baritone, and bass files for a song. The app extracts the isolated voice from each stereo track, aligns the parts automatically, and gives you a four-part mixer.

name: Truck Masters: India Simulator
description: Drive Indian trucks across realistic roads, highways, cities and villages.

name: Tryst
description: Tryst is a private, local-only journal for your intimate life. It keeps everything on your phone — there is no account, no sign-up, no sync, and no internet access at all. The app declares no INTERNET permission, so your data simply cannot be sent anywhere. Privacy is the whole point, not an add-on: * No network. The app has no INTERNET permission, so nothing can leak to a server.

name: Tubester
description: Tubester lets you play the Hitster music board game using YouTube instead of a Spotify subscription. Point it at the QR code on a card and it opens the matching song in an external player of your choice, such as NewPipe or the YouTube app. A Hitster QR code contains only the card's identity, not the song.

name: Tuisku
description: Tuisku is a simple and lightweight notes app that encrypts your notes with the ChaCha20 algorithm stored internally, you can share these notes unencrypted (if you wanted to) using the share button ontop of the note editor. You can also disable screenshoting in Settings and view your encryption key there.

name: Tuner
description: The app listens through your microphone and shows in real time how close each note is, with a clean interface and no distractions. Features: * Chromatic tuner with automatic note detection * Precise pitch detection down to the cent * Light and Dark theme * No advertisements * No trackers * No unnecessary permissions Have fun!

name: TV Remote
description: TV Remote turns your Android TV into a self-hosted web remote that any device on your local network can control — phone, tablet, laptop — without installing any app on the controller device. HOW IT WORKS The app runs a tiny HTTP server (port 8080) directly on your TV. Open http:// tv-ip :8080 in any browser and you get a full remote control interface.

name: Unmark
description: Unmark lets you paint over a watermark, logo, or unwanted object in a photo and erase it, entirely on your phone, with no internet connection required and nothing uploaded anywhere. Watermark removal uses a small, pure-Kotlin nearest-fill and smoothing algorithm. There is no AI/ML model, no bundled weights, and no native code. See the project README for how it works.

name: UPI Expense Tracker
description: A wallet you glance at. UPI Expense Tracker is a 100% offline personal expense tracker for UPI payments. It quietly captures every payment you make, sorts it into categories, and shows your daily, weekly, and monthly spend plus an at-a-glance available balance — on the home screen and in home-screen widgets. There is no account, no cloud, no ads, and no tracking. Everything stays on your phone.

name: Vault Explorer
description: Vault Explorer opens and browses encrypted containers and vaults directly on your device -- VeraCrypt/TrueCrypt, LUKS, BitLocker, Cryptomator, gocryptfs, and CryFS, plus raw VHD/VHDX images -- without exporting your files unencrypted to shared storage.

name: Vibecheck: Private Mood Tracker
description: Vibecheck is a private, local-first mood and symptom tracker designed for complete privacy, ease of use, and low friction.

name: Void Player
description: VoidPlayer is a premium, open-source local music player for Android, crafted with Kotlin Multiplatform and Jetpack Compose. It is designed with a heavy emphasis on modern UI aesthetics, dynamic colors, and buttery smooth performance, without any ads, trackers, or hidden analytics.

name: Vone: Live, Video Party & Fun
description: Fun and efficient live social app

name: Voxscribe - Offline Voice Input
description: Voxscribe is an offline voice-input keyboard (input method) for Android. Hold the mic button to record; your speech is transcribed entirely on-device with whisper.cpp using a Whisper model file you supply yourself, and the result is written into the focused text field. Voxscribe is free software. It is published under the MIT open-source license.

name: WageBit
description: WageBit is a local-first dashboard for people who think about savings as preserved labor. Enter monthly income, monthly expenses, weekly and daily work hours, current BTC price, BTC lots with acquired dates, target expense years, cost-of-living increase, DCA amount, DCA frequency, current age, and BTC CAGR.

name: WhatsApp Messenger
description: Simple. Reliable. Private.

name: Where is my Train
description: Train app - Timetable & live running status without internet No Ads Metro Local

name: WhisperType Keyboard
description: WhisperType is a full Android input method (IME) with a real QWERTY keyboard plus offline voice dictation. Unlike dictation-only "keyboards" that only show a microphone button, WhisperType lets you type normally and use speech when you want.

name: Windy Live Wallpaper
description: Android live wallpaper visualizing local wind patterns, inspired by the Pixel 2017 live wallpaper. * Correct rendering on newer devices (the original shaders don't work at all). * Updated wind data (the official data was last updated in 2019). * Lower memory and CPU usage. * Optionally render static frames to effectively eliminate all resource usage. * More color schemes.

name: Work Profile VPN Switcher
description: An Android application that automatically manages the work profile when a VPN connection is active. When VPN connects, the work profile is disabled. When VPN disconnects, the previous state is optionally restored. Useful when the work profile contains apps that should not run through the VPN tunnel, or when you need to isolate work apps from VPN traffic.

name: Worms Zone .io - Hungry Snake
description: A fun, dynamic game with cool graphics! Get growing your worm right now!

name: Wortmühle
description: Wortmühle ("word mill") is a daily German word puzzle: build as many German words as you can from the nine letters on the 3×3 mill board. Every word must use the center letter, and every puzzle contains at least one pangram — a word using all nine letters.

name: WPS Office-PDF, Word, Sheet
description: Edit PDF, Word, Docs, Excel & PPT. Scan, Convert, Sign PDFs & Write with AI.

name: Wristotle Companion
description: Wristotle turns your Pebble watch's dictation button into a voice command surface on your phone — calls, texts, reminders, alarms, music control, notes, tasks, meetings, weather, sports, world clock, calculator, a morning brief, and an Ask-Agent path that can hit any MCP server you configure. Everything runs on-device by default.

name: xlog2
description: xlog2 is an amateur-radio (ham) logging application. This is its mobile field-logging client: log QSOs (contacts) on your phone in the field and have them appear on your desktop station automatically — and vice-versa. The phone is not a separate logbook that you sync later.

name: XMRPod
description: XMRPod is an open-source Android podcast player with Monero tipping support for creators on XMRChat. No tracking, no analytics, no ads. The playback screen includes a Tip action for podcasts whose creators have an XMRChat page. Discovery happens entirely on your device: XMRPod downloads a single generic list of public creator pages and matches your subscribed feeds against it locally.

name: XPENC
description: XPENC is a personal finance app that keeps every rupee on your phone. There is no server, no account to create and no ads — your transactions live in a private database on your device and never leave it. Release builds do not even request the INTERNET permission, so transmitting your data is technically impossible. Honest numbers. Most expense apps blur where money sits with what it was for.

name: ylih - your life in headphones
description: Headphones die. Before they do, ylih answers the only question that really matters about a pair: how many hours did you get out of them? Every time your headphones connect, ylih writes down when. Every time they disconnect, it writes down when. That is the whole idea — and because a connection is just two timestamps, the app does not need to run in the background to do it.

name: YtReader
description: YtReader turns YouTube into a focused reading experience. Search for videos, follow subtitles with synchronized highlighting, and save the parts that matter.

name: Yumi Co. Radio
description: Take Yumi Co. Radio with you wherever you go. Yumi Co. Radio is a 24/7 online radio station dedicated to Future Funk, City Pop, Nu Disco and Vaporwave. Its official Android app brings the station to your phone with a native player and a distinctive retro Windows 9x look.

name: Zaragoza Tarjeta Bus
description: Free Android app that reads your Zaragoza transport card and displays remaining balance in euros, recent trips and top-ups.
